name: macOS Vendor DNS and bounded-read-only evidence adapter
description: Supported macOS adapter manifest limited to DNS-explicit-resolver observation and bounded read-only evidence. Provides typed untrusted observations implementing registered capabilities; never decides truth, policy, or remediation. OS-wide mappings are UNIMPLEMENTED intentionally.

forbidden_actions.action: Write /etc/resolv.conf, networksetup -setdnsservers, or scutil DNS keys on target
forbidden_actions.reason: Adapter path is read-only observation. Resolver writes are operator-owned remediation only.

forbidden_actions.action: sudo / admin escalation from adapter invocation
forbidden_actions.reason: No authority promotion beyond bounded read-only.

declared_capabilities.name: DNS explicit resolver observe for macOS
declared_capabilities.description: Read-only observation of explicit DNS resolver configuration on macOS via scutil --dns for the DNS-explicit-resolver invariant.

notes: Full OS-wide macOS adapter beyond DNS v0 remains UNIMPLEMENTED; only the DNS inspection capability above is SUPPORTED. Directory presence alone is intentionally NOT sufficient for support status.
